findings.claim: This PR's lever (ops/conductor/onboard-lever.md:57-58) now requires that state.json name a live worker pid, but dispatch_is_running implements that as os.kill(int(state['pid']), 0) with no worker identity. kill(2) documents that sig 0 succeeds for a zombie (ESRCH note: a terminated process still exists until wait(2)) and checks pid/pgid existence, not that the recorded harness is still the occupant. The lane already states the reuse hole in ops/conductor/tools/watchdog.py:159-162 (process_alive matches cmdline so a reused pid does not read as the worker). Impact: a record that is still status=launched after the worker has gone can remain in running= when the pid is a zombie or has been reused; that is the same census class this slice was opened to stop, now reduced to the process-table remainder. Not P1 under the owner-trusted lane model (jobs.json security-audit / D-LAUNCHER-1): it does not break integrity or reach outside a job; workers are the lane's own. The measured misses (died/invalid, no record.json) are excluded by status and fail-closed reads. Bounded closure is a truthful lever sentence and/or pid>0, not a new supervisor. Source (read, not a behavioral run): nl -ba ops/conductor/tools/onboard.py | sed -n '174,187p'; nl -ba ops/conductor/onboard-lever.md | sed -n '55,60p'; nl -ba ops/conductor/tools/watchdog.py | sed -n '159,180p'; nl -ba ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py | sed -n '1346,1359p'; man 2 kill.
findings.reproduce: SOURCE (executed): nl -ba ops/conductor/tools/onboard.py | sed -n '174,187p'; man 2 kill. UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS (not run; owner deferred testing): plant a launched record+state.json whose pid is a SIGKILL'd unreaped child or os.getpid(), then call dispatch_is_running; expected True for both zombie and unrelated live pid.

findings.claim: int(state['pid']) is passed to os.kill without requiring pid>0. kill(2): pid 0 signals the caller's process group; pid<-1 signals process group -pid; sig 0 still reports success when the group exists. A state.json with pid 0, a negative pgid, or another coercible non-worker value can therefore be listed as running. Impact: false running= on malformed state, not on the trusted launcher path (launch.py:779 writes proc.pid from Popen, always positive). P3 under D-LAUNCHER-1: defensive gap, not an observed lane failure and not a job-escape. Same bounded correction as the P2 (pid>0 before kill-0). Source (read): nl -ba ops/conductor/tools/onboard.py | sed -n '184,184p'; nl -ba ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py | sed -n '773,781p'; man 2 kill.
findings.reproduce: SOURCE (executed): nl -ba ops/conductor/tools/onboard.py | sed -n '174,187p'; man 2 kill. UNEXECUTED HYPOTHESIS (not run; owner deferred testing): plant record.json status=launched, state.json pid 0 or -1, no exit file; expected running= includes that id because os.kill(0,0)/os.kill(-N,0) returns success.
